# Comprehensive Requirements Quality Checklist: Next.js LTS Upgrade, Server-Side Logging & Biome Toolchain

**Purpose**: Validate requirements quality, completeness, and clarity for Next.js 16 Active LTS migration, Pino structured server-side logging, sensitive data obfuscation, request correlation tracking, and Biome toolchain consolidation before implementation and review.
**Created**: 2026-09-14
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

---

## 1. Runtime & Framework Modernization (Next.js 16 & Node.js 24)

- [ ] CHK001 Are asynchronous access requirements explicitly defined for all server-side request APIs (`cookies`, `headers`, and dynamic route `params`)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 Does the specification define fallback or migration behavior for existing synchronous cookie readers in authentication and repository factories? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 1]
- [ ] CHK003 Are Node.js 24 runtime version requirements documented across both local development and Netlify build environments? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the bundler expectation (Turbopack) clearly documented with requirements on build script parity? [Clarity, Spec §User Story 1]
- [ ] CHK005 Are regression prevention requirements defined for existing unit and integration test suites during framework upgrade? [Coverage, Spec §SC-007]

---

## 2. Server-Side Structured Logging (Pino)

- [ ] CHK006 Are all six standard log severity levels (`trace`, `debug`, `info`, `warn`, `error`, `fatal`) explicitly enumerated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK007 Are the default logging thresholds for production (`info`) and development (`debug`) unambiguously specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK008 Are the formatting differences between local development (`NODE_ENV=development` human-readable) and production (raw JSON) clearly bounded? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK009 Does the specification define required envelope attributes (`time`, `level`, `pid`, `hostname`, `correlationId`, `msg`) for machine-readable JSON logs? [Completeness, Spec §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK010 Are requirements specified for logging structured error metadata and stack traces without crashing the logging process? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 2, Edge Cases]

---

## 3. Data Protection, Obfuscation & Length Guardrails

- [ ] CHK011 Is the default set of sensitive property keys explicitly cataloged in the requirements? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the mechanism for extending the sensitive keys list via `LOG_OBFUSCATE_KEYS` clearly defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the maximum recursion depth (5 levels) for nested object and array inspection unambiguously specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK014 Are circular reference handling requirements documented to prevent infinite recursion during payload sanitization? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK015 Does the specification define the non-production restriction when disabling obfuscation via `LOG_OBFUSCATION_ENABLED`? [Security, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the truncation threshold (`LOG_MAX_LENGTH`) defined as applying to individual field values rather than outer JSON envelopes? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, SC-004]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the truncation visual indicator (`... [TRUNCATED]`) explicitly specified for audit clarity? [Clarity, Spec §User Story 3]

---

## 4. Request Correlation & Distributed Traceability

- [ ] CHK018 Is the header resolution precedence (`x-correlation-id` with fallback UUID generation) explicitly specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK019 Are sanitization requirements documented for handling oversized or malformed incoming `x-correlation-id` headers? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK020 Does the specification require automatic correlation ID attachment across all log statements within the request lifecycle? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the inclusion of `correlationId` specified for both the `x-correlation-id` response header AND client-facing JSON error bodies (`{ code, message, correlationId }`)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012, Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK022 Are contextual attribution requirements defined for optional `userId` and `contractId` attributes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013, FR-014]
- [ ] CHK023 Is the behavior for unauthenticated public requests (omitting or nullifying `userId` and `contractId`) clearly specified? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 4]

---

## 5. Toolchain Consolidation (Biome Migration)

- [ ] CHK024 Are all legacy ESLint and Prettier configuration files and dependencies scheduled for removal explicitly listed? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK025 Are the target workspace commands (`pnpm lint`, `pnpm format`, `pnpm check`) documented with exact Biome CLI parity? [Consistency, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the code formatting style continuity (2 spaces, single quotes, 100 character line width) explicitly documented to prevent noisy git diffs? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK027 Does the specification enforce the Constitutional Quality Gate requiring zero linting, formatting, or type-checking errors? [Traceability, Spec §SC-006, Constitution §Development Workflow]
- [ ] CHK028 Can the static analysis and lint execution time reduction ($\ge 40\%$ improvement / $< 3$s locally) be objectively measured? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, SC-006]
